title: Solutions Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At Sisense, we help organizations turn complex data into actionable intelligence. As a Senior Solution Architect, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and optimizing enterprise-grade analytics deployments for customers with complex technical and business needs. You will partner closely with customers, internal stakeholders, and product teams to ensure successful outcomes across architecture, deployment, scalability, and long-term value realization.


Employment Type : Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2B)


WHY JOIN OUR SOLUTION ARCHITECT TEAM?

  • You will work at the intersection of customer success, cloud architecture, and data platforms.
  • You will help customers solve complex infrastructure, deployment, and performance challenges across Sisense environments.
  • You will collaborate with Product, R&D, Support, and Customer Success to shape best practices and improve the platform.
  • You will influence architecture decisions for strategic customers and high-visibility engagements.


IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

  • Lead custom multi-node Linux installations and upgrades for Sisense deployments, including troubleshooting complex deployment issues.
  • Own and troubleshoot multi-node Windows-to-Linux migration projects, backup and restore processes, and architecture-related escalations.
  • Perform load testing, interpret results, and provide strategic recommendations for scaling, performance, and resource optimization.
  • Analyze logs, system performance, and infrastructure telemetry to proactively identify risks and optimize customer environments.
  • Partner with customer Application Developers, DevOps, IT teams, and executive sponsors to drive successful outcomes.
  • Act as the voice of the customer by sharing product feedback, submitting bugs and feature requests, and influencing roadmap priorities.
  • Lead enablement for internal teams, mentor Solution Architects, and support technical interviews for new hires.


WHAT YOU’VE ACCOMPLISHED… SO FAR:

  • 5+ years of related experience in customer-facing technical roles, with prior experience as a Solution Architect.
  • Hands-on expertise with Linux (Ubuntu, Amazon Linux, RHEL/CentOS), Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, and cloud platforms such as AWS EKS / GKE.
  • Strong experience troubleshooting distributed systems, networking, security, and system monitoring tools such as Grafana and Coralogix.
  • Advanced working knowledge of MongoDB (or another NoSQL database), including query optimization and troubleshooting.
  • Intermediate SQL skills with the ability to join data across disparate sources and optimize queries.
  • Proficiency in scripting and coding with Bash, Python, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Experience with load testing tools such as K6 and with modern cloud data warehouse technologies (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery) is a plus.
  • Strong customer communication skills, with the ability to engage technical teams and executive stakeholders.


HOW YOU’LL RAMP:

  • By Day 30: Build a strong understanding of Sisense architecture, deployment models, product capabilities, and customer engagement processes.
  • By Day 60: Independently lead standard and custom deployment activities, troubleshoot escalations, and support customer architecture reviews.
  • By Day 90: Own complex technical engagements end-to-end, mentor junior team members, and contribute to internal best practices and enablement.

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based

title: Especialista FinOps
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Especialista FinOps em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Especialista FinOps


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista FinOps para liderar iniciativas de governança financeira em ambientes cloud, promovendo a otimização contínua de custos, eficiência operacional e maximização do retorno dos investimentos em tecnologia.

O profissional atuará como referência técnica e estratégica em FinOps, colaborando diretamente com equipes de Arquitetura, Infraestrutura, Engenharia, Finanças, Produtos e Liderança Executiva. Sua missão será transformar dados de consumo em decisões inteligentes, garantindo governança, previsibilidade financeira e uso eficiente dos recursos em nuvem.

Buscamos um perfil altamente analítico, consultivo e orientado a resultados, capaz de influenciar decisões técnicas e financeiras em ambientes corporativos de grande porte.


Principais Responsabilidades

☁️ Gestão e Otimização Financeira de Cloud

Identificar continuamente oportunidades de redução de custos e aumento da eficiência operacional em ambientes Microsoft Azure;

Definir a visão estratégica do produto e gerir o backlog de prioridades com foco no valor de negócio, assegurando que as entregas da equipa de desenvolvimento atendam às necessidades dos utilizadores e aos objetivos da empresa.

title: Analista de Serviços Técnicos – Concreto e Cimento
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Serviços Técnicos – Concreto e Cimento em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Líder global em construção leve e sustentável, a Saint-Gobain projeta, fabrica e distribui materiais e serviços para os mercados de construção e indústria. Suas soluções integradas para a reforma, construção leve e descarbonização da construção e da indústria, são desenvolvidas por meio de um processo de inovação contínua e promovem sustentabilidade e performance.


Quer fazer parte deste Time?


  • Área: Serviços Técnicos - A área técnica atua diretamente como suporte estratégico ao comercial, sendo fundamental para fechamento de vendas. A venda dos produtos é altamente técnica (aditivos para concreto e cimento).
  • Horário: Segunda a Sexta, das 08h às 17h
  • Modelo de trabalho: Serviço Externo em Salvador - Bahia;
  • Viagens frequentes: Até 50% ou mais do tempo. Média: 2 semanas na Bahia, e 2 semanas em outras regiões como Pernambuco.

Papel na equipe:

  • Complementa atuação dos engenheiros de vendas
  • Gera dados técnicos para apoiar negociações
  • Atua como suporte em oportunidades simultâneas

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Fornece suporte técnico especializado para clientes internos e externos, ajudando na seleção e aplicação correta dos aditivos para concreto e cimento.
  • Planejar e executar testes em laboratórios ou em campo para implementação ou avaliação de novos produtos;
  • Colaborar com as equipes de desenvolvimento de produtos para aprimorar ou desenvolver novos aditivos que atendam às demandas do mercado e superem os desafios técnicos dos clientes.
  • Analisar e reportar resultados de testes de suporte em formatos padronizados - RFTS;
  • Conduzir treinamentos e workshops para clientes e equipes internas sobre a utilização e benefícios dos aditivos, além de manter-se atualizado com as inovações e tendências do setor
  • Representar a organização em eventos, associações e feiras técnicas;
  • Trabalhar diretamente com os clientes para entender suas necessidades específicas e desenvolver soluções personalizadas que otimizem o desempenho dos seus projetos de construção.
  • Prestar consultoria técnica a clientes (externos e internos) em questões relacionadas a especificações de produtos, processos e soluções de problemas;
  • Assegurar que os produtos atendam aos padrões de qualidade e conformidade regulamentar, realizando testes e avaliações técnicas quando necessário.
  • Colaborar com a equipe de vendas, fornecendo informações técnicas e suporte durante o processo de vendas para ajudar a fechar negócios e expandir a base de clientes.

Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Técnico em Edificações ou Laboratorista de Concreto
  • CNH ativa
  • Disponibilidade e disposição para viagens
  • Diferencial: Engenharia Civil ou Tecnólogo em Obras

Experiência

  • Experiência comprovada na indústria do concreto
  • Vivência com: Ensaios laboratoriais, Dosagem de concreto, Controle tecnológico, Processos industriais
  • Diferencial: experiência com aditivos

Highlight Role of the Week!


Customer Service Specialist (Remote)


About the role:


This opportunity is designed for experienced customer service professionals who are comfortable managing multi-channel support operations, resolving complex inquiries, handling escalations, and delivering high-quality customer experiences in fast-paced remote environments.


Pay Rates:


Part-Time Monthly Rates : $840-$$1,400 (based on 20 hours per week schedule)


Full-Time Monthly Rates : $1,680-$2,800 (based on 40 hours per week schedule)


The posted monthly salary range is an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly, and pay is calculated based on the number of hours worked daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10.50 - $17.50, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.


Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the position and client. Most schedules align with U.S. and Canadian business hours.


Key responsibilities:


  • Multi-Channel Customer Support: Handle customer inquiries across phone, email, live chat, and social media, ensuring timely, professional, and solution-oriented responses.
  • Escalation & Problem Resolution: Diagnose complex customer issues, troubleshoot effectively, and manage escalations through resolution while maintaining customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Account Management & CRM Administration: Update and maintain accurate customer records, process account changes, and ensure data integrity within CRM and helpdesk systems (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, or similar).
  • Product & Service Expertise: Maintain deep knowledge of products, services, and internal processes to provide accurate guidance and proactive recommendations to customers.
  • Reporting & Process Improvement: Document customer interactions, identify recurring issues and trends, and provide actionable feedback to support teams and leadership to improve service quality.


Depending on the client, you may also support order processing, returns management, knowledge base maintenance, or quality assurance initiatives.


What you bring:


  • Must be 21+ years old
  • 1+ years of experience in customer service, customer support, or client-facing roles
  • Bilingual English (C1 or above) / Spanish


Required Skills:


  • Strong understanding of customer service best practices, support workflows, and escalation procedures
  • Experience working with CRM or helpdesk platforms (Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot, Intercom, Salesforce Service Cloud, LiveAgent, Zoho Desk, or similar)
  • Familiarity with communication and collaboration tools (Slack, Microsoft Teams, Dialpad, RingCentral, Aircall, or similar)
  • Experience with ticketing and knowledge base systems (Jira Service Management, Help Scout, Confluence, Notion, or similar)
  • Proficiency in productivity and scheduling tools (Google Workspace, Microsoft Office 365, Calendly, or similar)
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish
  • Ability to manage multiple conversations and priorities simultaneously in remote environments
  • Strong organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail
  • Empathetic, patient communication style with a focus on customer retention
  • Comfortable handling confidential customer information with discretion


How the process works:


  • Apply through LinkedIn Easy Apply.
  • Qualified candidates will receive instructions to complete their full application and join the Virtual Latinos community.
  • Once accepted, you will gain access to ongoing remote job opportunities with U.S. companies looking for experienced remote professionals.

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

  • Support operational teams in adopting new technologies
  • Provide training and documentation for system usage and best practices

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems
  • Solid understanding of electro-mechanical systems, sensors, and control systems
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly (nationally and/or internationally) to support project deployments and client sites


Nice to Have

  • Experience in project management (PMP or equivalent is a plus)
  • Knowledge of programming/scripting (Python or similar)
  • Experience with data analysis and performance optimization
  • Background in industrial engineering, robotics, or logistics systems
  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
  • System-level thinking and architecture mindset
  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

title: MES Business Analyst(Aveva)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para MES Business Analyst(Aveva) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Summary:

  • Our client is looking for a MES Global Business Analyst. Needs to have senior level MES skills, with at least 1 Aveva project. Focus is more from the business side but needs to be able to interact with the technical team and will need some hands on Aveva experience.
  • This role supports a large-scale MES program across 26 sites, acting as a global business system owner with strong functional accountability for harmonizing manufacturing processes, shaping MES capabilities, and ensuring business alignment across implementations.


Responsibilities

  • Collect user requirements from sites and drive standardization and harmonization of MES-supported manufacturing processes
  • Support the definition of core MES data structures such as Master batch records, materials, resources, and master data
  • Review functional solution design proposed by the system integrator and escalate gaps, risks, or misalignment with business needs
  • Monitor and control solution definition across multiple parallel implementations to ensure consistency of core MES functions
  • Oversee UAT preparation and execution, ensuring test scenarios adequately cover critical manufacturing and compliance processes
  • Assess change impacts at site level, including process adoption, training needs, and local operational readiness
  • Production of project status reports and functional progress updates for MES deployments
  • Escalation management for process, design, and deployment issues affecting MES implementation
  • Coordination of cross-functional teams involved in MES design, testing, and rollout
  • Support global business activities related to manufacturing execution, electronic batch records, and process standardization
  • Support the global business application owner in functional maintenance, enhancement prioritization, and solution testing and governance


Required Qualifications

  • At least 5-7 years of experience in OT/IT projects within manufacturing, including significant exposure to MES implementation as a business representative or functional lead
  • Strong functional understanding of MES capabilities such as electronic batch records, recipe/workflow execution, material traceability, review by exception, and equipment status management
  • Experience translating site business needs into user requirements, process flows, and harmonized global solutions
  • Experience in GxP-regulated environments, ideally within pharmaceutical manufacturing
  • Good knowledge of pharma manufacturing processes, including batch execution, dispensing, weighing, and quality-related process controls
  • Experience working in Agile or hybrid project delivery models is preferred
  • Experience in MES implementation projects within regulated manufacturing environments, ideally in Pharma
  • Functional exposure to MES-related capabilities such as eBR, batch execution, material genealogy, deviation handling, review by exception, and integration with ERP/LIMS/warehouse systems
  • Experience with GxP documentation, validation support, and controlled deployment of digital manufacturing solutions
  • Ability to quickly understand and adopt new MES platforms and technologies


Musts:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years MES experience
  • At least 1 project on Aveva MES
  • Business Analyst experience, with enough technical expertise to interface with the technical team
  • Integration with SAP
  • Integration with the L2 layer (Scada, PLCs etc), so they can understand process flows
  • Experience with eBR, batch execution
  • UAT experience
  • Latin America based


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with other MES solutions would be nice to have, not essential
  • Brazil based

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.


Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.
  • Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits.
  • Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma.
  • Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives.
  • Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders.


Nice to have

  • Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar).
  • Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms.
  • Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar).
  • Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique.
  • Working knowledge of HTML/CSS; JavaScript a plus.
  • Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.


Please submit your application with an English-language CV/resume and a portfolio showcasing relevant work samples.

Especialista FinOps

O profissional atuará como referência técnica e estratégica em FinOps, colaborando diretamente com equipes de Arquitetura, Infraestrutura, Engenharia, Finanças, Produtos e Liderança Executiva. Atuar na definição de modelos de accountability financeira entre áreas de negócio e tecnologia;

Participar de fóruns, comitês de governança e iniciativas de evolução da maturidade FinOps.

Desenvolver modelos de previsão de consumo e gastos (forecast);

Realizar análises preditivas baseadas em tendências e históricos de utilização;

Avaliar impactos financeiros de novos projetos, arquiteturas e iniciativas cloud;

Apoiar a construção de business cases, análises de ROI, TCO e planejamento orçamentário;

Estruturar KPIs e indicadores estratégicos para acompanhamento financeiro dos ambientes cloud.

description:

Location: Brazil/Remote

Contract: Permanent / Freelance

Experience Level: Senior

Language: English and Portuguese



Mission Overview

We are looking for a Senior Warehouse Automation Specialist to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced automation solutions within distribution and logistics environments.

You will act as a key System Engineer , bridging operational needs with cutting-edge technologies such as robotics, RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems), and machine vision systems to drive efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in complex environments and enjoys combining technical expertise, data analysis, and project leadership to transform warehouse operations.


Key Responsibilities

System Design & Implementation

  • Design and deploy automated warehouse systems (AS/RS, conveyors, AGVs, robotic picking solutions)
  • Integrate RTLS solutions for real-time tracking of assets and inventory
  • Lead end-to-end system architecture aligned with operational requirements

Technical Optimization & Performance

  • Analyze workflows and system performance to identify bottlenecks
  • Implement data-driven improvements to maximize throughput and efficiency
  • Optimize warehouse execution systems (WES), warehouse management systems (WMS), and automation tools

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

  • Monitor and ensure high availability of automation systems (robotics, sensors, vision systems)
  • Diagnose and resolve system issues across hardware and software layers
  • Maintain system documentation and continuous improvement processes

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead or contribute to automation projects from concept to deployment
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (operations, IT, engineering)
  • Ensure minimal disruption to live operations during implementation

Training & Change Management

Safety & Compliance

  • Ensure all systems comply with safety standards and industry regulations
  • Contribute to improving workplace safety and ergonomics


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in warehouse automation, system engineering, or industrial automation
  • Proven experience with RTLS (Real-Time Locating Systems)
  • Strong background in machine vision systems
  • Hands-on experience with:
  • WMS / WES systems
  • Robotics, AGVs, or automated material handling systems

  • Portuguese knowledge


Key Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities

  • Ability to work in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Sobre a Empresa

Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.

Descrição da função

Definir a visão estratégica do produto e gerir o backlog de prioridades com foco no valor de negócio, assegurando que as entregas da equipa de desenvolvimento atendam às necessidades dos utilizadores e aos objetivos da empresa.

Atuar como Product Owner responsável pela gestão do backlog e evolução das integrações, com foco em soluções baseadas em APIs e Webhooks , garantindo entregas com qualidade, prioridade adequada e aderência às necessidades de negócio.


Responsabilidades principais

  • Definir, priorizar e gerir o backlog das integrações (APIs, Webhooks e eventos)

Conhecimento prático de:

  • monitoramento e tratamento de falhas em integrações

title: Analista de Controladoria Sr
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Controladoria Sr em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Elaborar e consolidar o orçamento anual da área comercial, bem como prestar suporte na elaboração do orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.
  • Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.
  • Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.
  • Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.
  • Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.
  • Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.
  • Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).
  • Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.
  • Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.
  • Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.
  • Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.
  • Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.
  • Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.
  • Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.


Requisitos:

  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.
  • Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.
  • Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.
  • Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.
  • Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.
  • Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.
  • Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.
  • Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.
  • Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.
  • Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.
  • Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).


Aviso Legal:

Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.


Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.


Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Full Stack Engineer (AI)
description:

AI-Native Full-Stack Developer

Go • React • AWS • Cloudflare Edge

Full-Time Contractor | Long-Term Opportunity


Details:

  • Location: 100% remote — Brazil only
  • Type: Full-time contractor
  • Schedule: 40 hours per week
  • Compensation: ($4000 to $7000 USD) Competitive monthly contractor rate in USD, based on experience
  • Duration: Long-term engagement
  • Language: Strong English communication required
  • Start Date: As soon as possible, depending on availability



About the Opportunity


OttoMate Global is hiring an AI-Native Full-Stack Developer for a confidential U.S.-based technology client building modern AI-powered platforms and digital transformation solutions. This is a high-impact opportunity to join a forward-thinking team that is redefining how software is built using AI-assisted and agentic development workflows .


This is not a traditional full-stack role.

We are looking for a developer who already uses AI as part of their daily engineering workflow — someone who works with tools like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot , or similar platforms to plan, build, test, review, and ship production-ready software.You will work across the full product stack, including Go backend services, React/Vite frontend, APIs, AWS, Cloudflare Edge, and modern AI-native development workflows .




What You’ll Do

  • Build and ship end-to-end product features across frontend, backend, APIs, and cloud environments.
  • Develop backend services and APIs using Go / Golang .
  • Build modern frontend experiences using React, TypeScript, and Vite .
  • Work with cloud and edge technologies, including AWS and Cloudflare Workers / Cloudflare Edge .
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to move faster while maintaining strong code quality.
  • Work with agentic workflows, AI agents, MCP, tool calls, LLM workflows, or similar AI engineering concepts.
  • Build reliable, container-friendly services using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD , and modern engineering practices.
  • Write, run, and debug tests to make sure features are production-ready.
  • Collaborate with a distributed team through clear written and verbal communication.


Required Skills

  • Strong experience with Go / Golang .
  • Strong experience with React and TypeScript .
  • Experience with Vite or modern frontend build tools.
  • Experience building and consuming APIs.
  • Strong understanding of full-stack system design.
  • Experience with AWS services such as EC2, EKS/Kubernetes, S3, RDS/Aurora, IAM, or VPC.
  • Experience with Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare Edge , or similar edge/serverless technologies.
  • Experience using AI coding tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Augment, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT , or similar tools.
  • Solid Linux, Bash, Docker, CI/CD, and testing experience.
  • Strong English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-moving remote environment.


How to Apply

To be considered, please apply directly to this job on LinkedIn with an updated CV that includes:

  • Your current location.
  • A brief summary of your experience with Go, React, AWS, Cloudflare, and AI-assisted development tools.
  • Examples of projects or systems you have built using Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, MCP, AI agents, or similar tools.


Important

Only candidates currently based in Brazil will be considered. This is a 100% remote, full-time contractor opportunity.


OttoMate is proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We are committed to building a workforce that is representative of the users we serve, creating a culture of belonging, and

providing equal employment opportunity regardless of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information

orçamento das áreas de Administração de Vendas, Trading, Merchandising e/ou Marketing.Conduzir mensalmente o processo de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast), interagindo com as áreas internas para entendimento dos desvios e proposição de ações corretivas e preventivas.Elaborar e atualizar o Forecast, garantindo acuracidade, consistência dos drivers e alinhamento com a estratégia do negócio.Executar e manter as rotinas de pricing da Empresa, assegurando coerência entre custos, margens, impostos, políticas comerciais e estratégia competitiva.Analisar dados de vendas, custos, margens e preços vigentes, recomendando ajustes de preço com base em rentabilidade, elasticidade, posicionamento de mercado e sustentabilidade financeira.Realizar estudos de precificação de novos produtos, considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, benchmark de mercado e impacto no portfólio.Analisar a rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal, recomendando ações para melhoria de margem e mix.Suportar os processos de gestão, controle e análise das verbas comerciais, assegurando correta alocação, execução e mensuração de retorno (ROI).Monitorar impactos das ações comerciais nos resultados, margens e indicadores financeiros.Analisar e consolidar informações de vendas, custos e despesas, garantindo aderência ao planejado.Produzir relatórios gerenciais de resultados e desempenho financeiro, com análises críticas e recomendações executivas.Realizar apresentações e reuniões com áreas internas para demonstração de resultados, análises financeiras e orçamentárias.Analisar e liberar requisições de compra, conforme políticas internas e orçamento aprovado.Apoiar o desenvolvimento técnico dos demais membros da equipe de Controladoria, disseminando boas práticas.Executar suas atividades em conformidade com normas técnicas, procedimentos internos, políticas de qualidade, segurança do trabalho e meio ambiente.Realizar outras atividades correlatas, compatíveis com o cargo, conforme orientação do superior imediato.Requisitos:Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia ou áreas correlatas.Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA. Excel avançado incluindo modelagem financeira e construção de modelos de pricing, margem e rentabilidade, uso avançado de funções (ÍNDICE, CORRESP, SOMASES, PROCV/XLOOKUP, SE, MATRIZ, LET, LAMBDA), Tabelas Dinâmicas avançadas, Power Query e Power Pivot para tratamento, consolidação e análise de grandes volumes de dados.Vivência com planejamento financeiro, orçamento e Forecast, com domínio de análise de variações (Real x Orçado / Forecast) e identificação de drivers de resultado.Vivência com custos e formação de preços incluindo conceitos de custo standard, custo médio e margem de contribuição, sistemas de custeio (absorção, real e padrão) e análise de rentabilidade por produto, linha, cliente e canal.Experiência com pricing e rentabilidade, com capacidade de modelar preços considerando custos, impostos, margens-alvo, mix e estratégia comercial, realizar simulações de cenários e análises de impacto econômico-financeiro e suportar negociações comerciais com dados, argumentos e análises estruturadas.Experiência com gestão e controle de verbas comerciais, incluindo análise de retorno sobre investimento (ROI), mensuração de impactos em margem, volume e resultado e acompanhamento da execução orçamentária das ações comerciais.Conhecimento em impostos indiretos (ICMS, PIS, COFINS) e seus impactos na formação de preços, margens e rentabilidade e nos princípios de contabilidade e finanças, com capacidade de análise de demonstrações financeiras, reconhecimento de receitas e despesas e entendimento dos impactos contábeis nas decisões de negócio.Conhecimento do processo comercial e logístico, entendendo seus reflexos em custos, preços, nível de serviço e capital de giro.Conhecimento com ferramentas de BI e visualização de dados (Power BI, Tableau ou similares), com capacidade de construir dashboards gerenciais e executivos, analisar indicadores como margem, pricing waterfall, ROI de verbas comerciais, forecast accuracy e traduzir dados complexos em insights claros para tomada de decisão.Experiência com manipulação e análise de bases de dados massivas, garantindo consistência, rastreabilidade e governança da informação.Experiência com Sistemas Integrados (ERP), com habilidade para extração, validação e cruzamento de dados financeiros e comerciais e entendimento dos impactos de cadastros, condições comerciais e impostos nos resultados.Desejável Inglês (leitura, escrita e conversação).Aviso Legal:Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Business Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

1, Document Preparation and Analysis (Pre-Shipment): This phase focuses on ensuring all documentation is correct before shipment. It includes receiving and checking the Purchase Order (PO), the fiscal classification (NCM) of the goods, analyzing draft documents (CI, PL, BL drafts), and initial registration in the system.2, Shipment Management and Customs Procedures: This stage covers the active management of the process while the cargo is in transit. It involves obtaining the Import License (LI), collecting original documents, validating the Bill of Lading (BL), and continuous coordination with the customs broker and the bonded terminal.3, Clearance Monitoring and Closing (Post-Arrival): This phase begins upon cargo arrival. It includes full door-to-door logistics follow-up, cargo presence confirmation, monitoring customs clearance (DI/DUIMP), coordinating domestic transport, and finally, archiving all documents to close the process.4, Invoice Auditing and Cost Validation: This phase focuses on verifying the accuracy of all operational costs before payment. It includes receiving and cross-referencing invoices (from freight forwarders, carriers, terminals, customs brokers) against negotiated tariffs, operational records, and system data (e.G., demurrage/detention days, storage fees) to identify and dispute discrepancies.5, Payment Processing and Budget Allocation: This stage covers the financial execution and control. It involves launching approved invoices into the financial system (ERP), correctly allocating all costs to the specific import process or cost center, scheduling payments according to financial policy, and serving as the main point of contact for supplier payment inquiries.6, Cost Analysis and Performance Reporting: This final phase focuses on data analysis and strategic support. It includes compiling financial data, generating periodic reports (e.G., total logistics cost, cost-per-container, variance analysis against budget), and providing data-driven insights to support new supplier negotiations and identify cost-saving opportunities.

title: Desenhista Copista
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenhista Copista em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função de Desenhista Copista em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:Elaborar e revisar desenhos técnicos de peças, equipamentos e conjuntos mecânicos conforme demanda da manutenção.Atualizar desenhos existentes com base em modificações realizadas em campo (as-built).Garantir a padronização dos desenhos quanto a layout, nomenclatura, identificação e controle de revisões.Desenvolver e manter um padrão de organização, catalogação e arquivamento dos desenhos técnicos.Definir e aplicar critérios de codificação e identificação de documentos, garantindo rastreabilidade e controle de versões.Controlar revisões de desenhos, assegurando a disponibilidade apenas de documentos válidos para utilização.Realizar o cadastro e anexação de documentos técnicos no SAP, conforme estrutura de equipamentos e locais de instalação.Garantir a correta vinculação dos desenhos aos respectivos objetos técnicos no SAP (equipamentos e locais de instalação).Apoiar na organização e manutenção da base de dados técnicos da manutenção.Auxiliar no cadastro e atualização de informações em ordens de manutenção, listas técnicas e planos de manutenção.Apoiar as rotinas administrativas do PCM, incluindo controles, relatórios e organização de documentos.Dar suporte à equipe de manutenção na consulta e interpretação de desenhos técnicos.Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na organização documental e propor padronizações.Atuar de forma integrada com PCM, Engenharia e equipes de manutenção.Garantir o cumprimento dos padrões e procedimentos internos relacionados à gestão documental e manutenção.Requisitos:Ensino Técnico ou Superior em andamento (Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Mecatrônica ou áreas correlatas).Experiência em elaboração e revisão de desenhos técnicos em ambiente industrial.Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana - BA.Desejável experiência com rotinas de manutenção e suporte ao PCM.Conhecimento em Leitura e interpretação de desenho técnico mecânico, em ferramentas de desenho (AutoCAD, Inventor ou Fusion), em organização e gestão de documentação técnica.Noções de Planejamento e Controle de Manutenção (PCM).Vivência com Pacote Office (ênfase em Excel).Desejável conhecimento em estrutura de equipamentos e locais de instalação.Desejável vivência com SAP PM (especialmente gestão de documentos – DMS).Aviso LegalAo nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Analista de Suporte Técnico com foco em Desenvolvimento
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Suporte Técnico com foco em Desenvolvimento em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da Vaga


A H2W está em busca de Analista de Suporte Técnico com foco em Desenvolvimento para atuar na sustentação de sistemas, garantindo estabilidade, correções e melhorias contínuas. Procuramos um profissional com visão analítica, boa comunicação e que goste de resolver problemas técnicos, atuando próximo à equipe de desenvolvimento e aos usuários.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições


  • Atender chamados de suporte técnico nível 2 e 3, analisando problemas e propondo soluções.
  • Reproduzir, diagnosticar e corrigir bugs em sistemas.
  • Realizar consultas, análises e ajustes simples em banco de dados (SQL).
  • Investigar logs, monitorar serviços e atuar preventivamente em incidentes.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica e procedimentos operacionais.
  • Sugerir melhorias técnicas, automações e ajustes de desempenho.
  • Interagir com áreas internas e clientes/usuários.

Requisitos (Obrigatórios)


  • Experiência com suporte técnico, sustentação ou análise de sistemas.
  • Conhecimento em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação: Java(jsp) / JavaScript / CSS / HTML
  • Experiência com banco de dados Relacional.
  • Familiaridade com Git e versionamento de código.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis)


  • Conhecimento intermediário em SQL Server (Views, Procedures, JOBs)
  • Conhecimentos em Testes Unitários.


Soft Skills


  • Boa comunicação e didática.
  • Perfil colaborativo e orientação a resultados.
  • Organização, documentação e visão de priorização.
  • Senso de dono (ownership) e forte habilidade de resolução de problemas.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Business Analyst (German) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Manager - Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting (Capital Markets) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Role

We are seeking a Manager in Accounting Advisory & Financial Reporting to join our growing team. This role is ideal for an experienced accounting professional with expertise in IFRS, US GAAP, and technical accounting matters, particularly in advising businesses through reporting and compliance challenges.


The ideal candidate will have experience in Big Four accounting firms, audit, and accounting advisory services , as well as exposure to multiple industries such as manufacturing, infrastructure, SaaS, retail, and professional services. This role offers an excellent opportunity to gain high-level advisory experience while working with senior leadership and supporting clients through complex accounting matters.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide technical accounting advisory services , including IFRS and US GAAP conversions, financial statement preparation, and complex transaction analysis.
  • Assist in advisory engagements related to financial reporting, internal controls, and accounting policy implementations.
  • Support CFOs, Controllers, and Finance teams with regulatory compliance, GAAP conversions, and implementation of new accounting standards.
  • Conduct research on technical accounting issues and provide recommendations for best practices.
  • Assist in M&A transactions by supporting purchase accounting, due diligence, and post-merger financial reporting.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve financial reporting and accounting processes.
  • Mentor and guide junior professionals, ensuring quality service delivery and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in accounting advisory, financial reporting, or external audit.
  • Big Four or global advisory firm experience is preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of IFRS, US GAAP, and other international accounting frameworks .
  • CPA, Chartered Accountant, or equivalent certification is required (or in progress).
  • Exposure to multiple industries (e.g., SaaS, manufacturing, retail, infrastructure) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects.
  • Excellent communication and client management skills.
  • Bilingual proficiency in Portuguese, Spanish, or English is a plus.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Coordinador de Planeamiento Supply Chain em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Empresa con gran trayectoria y de alcance internacional, se encuentra en la búsqueda de un talento:


Coordinador de Planeamiento y Demanda


¿Cuál es la Misión del puesto?


  • Liderar, integrar y hacer eficientes los procesos implicados en la cadena de suministro como son: estimación de la demanda, planificación de la cadena de abastecimiento, compras estratégicas, operaciones de planta y logística y transporte, lo cual implica una interacción y coordinación de acciones constante con los distintos referentes de áreas.
  • Definir el plan de demanda, plan de abastecimiento a los COs, producción y abastecimiento de materias primas e insumos, liderando a su equipo para que se realice de acuerdo a lo acordado.
  • Liderar los planes Estratégicos y planes de mediano y corto plazo de su área, así como liderar y desarrollar a su equipo en post de la incorporación de prácticas modernas de Planeamiento.
  • Plantear los objetivos del área en forma alineada con los objetivos de la Gerencia de Supply Chain y la Gerencia Corporativa.
  • Liderar y acompañar en la mejora continua del portafolio de la compañía a través del Proceso de Racionalización de SKUs (Cure & Kill) a partir de comités multifuncionales con los diversos actores a lo largo de la Cadena de Suministro.
  • Coordinar con las áreas de la compañía las tareas de limpieza de datos y mejora de procesos de ciclo de vida del producto.
  • Asegurar que no se tengan quiebres a través del correcto balance de producción y abastecimiento a COs oportunamente.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Liquidity Partnership Manager (LATAM) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview

We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes.


Key Responsibilities

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers
  • Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered)
  • Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms)


Market & Network Development

  • Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa)
  • Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape


Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality
  • Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships


Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations
  • Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement


Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners
  • Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets
  • Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics
  • Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM


Vision & Mission

  • OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.
  • OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.
